spans.s: ṛṭ-iti (also ṛg-, rig-iti, qq.v.), instantly: Mvy 〔8224〕 (also in Mironov); Dbh.g. 〔51(77).27〕, repeated 〔52(78).2, 18〕; the same line repeated with sapadi instead of ṛṭ-iti 〔52(78).6, 10, 14〕. But for the repeated occurrence one might suspect a merely graphic corruption for Skt. jhaṭiti (var. jhag-iti).
